mainEntity.name: Is microdermabrasion suitable for all skin types?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, it is gentle and safe for most skin types. Your dermatologist confirms suitability during the consultation.

mainEntity.name: How many sessions will I need?

acceptedAnswer.text: Most clients see results after 3–6 sessions, spaced 2–4 weeks apart.

mainEntity.name: Can it treat deep scars or wrinkles?

acceptedAnswer.text: It works best on superficial scars. Deeper concerns may need additional treatments such as laser therapy or MNRF.

mainEntity.name: How soon will I see results?

acceptedAnswer.text: You'll notice smoother, brighter skin right after the first session, with further improvement over a course of treatments.
